# `unbounded-loop`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: disciplined · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a `while` loop with no visible comparison bound, exhaustion condition,
or counter guard.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An unstated bound turns corrupted input or a missing event into a hang with no
declared worst case.

## When it fires

Iterator and reader exhaustion, sentinel traversal, queue drains, blocking
waits, event-loop dispatch, and retry-on-interruption loops are exempt.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn spin(flag: *bool) void {
    while (true) {
        flag.* = !flag.*;
    }
}
```
